verdicts.reason: The two layouts are identical except for how the headline wraps. Shared flaws: the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is tiny and floats on the decorative circle, away from the product. The SOLSTICE logo is too small to read. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column. The CTA nearly touches the right edge of the canvas. A breaks the headline as 'Chase the / Light', which splits the gold phrase and leaves 'Light' on its own line. B's 'Chase / the Light' keeps the coloured phrase together, so B is slightly better.
